$comment: Product-intent confirmation record. Two blocks are deliberately not merged: `intent` (what the owner said they meant to promote) and `observation` (what a link actually did). An ASIN is the checkable identifier — the official definition is in SRC-08.
rule: intent is never populated from observation, and observation is never written into intent. A redirect that happens to land somewhere is evidence about the redirect, not about the product.
sources_of_truth_allowed: the product detail page itself, screenshotted by a named human

observation.method: attempted from a sandbox with restricted egress; no resolution recorded

blocking_reasons: intended_asin fails the 10-character ASIN format check
no official listing URL to confirm against
no named human has confirmed the product
clear_when: official_listing_url recorded and matched to that ASIN
one link built in Associates Central and its destination checked
